title: The Sea Only Comes a Little Way
subtitle: The waves come in, and go back out
character: wearing a pale yellow t-shirt and orange shorts, bare feet, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, gentle watercolor painting, soft sea green and warm sand palette, loose wet washes, lots of white paper showing, calm soft daylight
neg_extra: stormy, huge crashing waves, dark water, deep ocean, frightening, dramatic

pages.zh:
我第一次来海边。
海好大好大，看不到边。
浪的声音轰隆隆的。
我抓紧了爸爸的手。
pages.scene: A little boy stands high on a wide empty sandy beach, far back from the water, holding a grown-up's hand, looking out at a very large calm sea under a big pale sky. He is small in the frame, sea and sky fill most of the picture, wide open composition.
pages.en:
It's my first time at the beach.
The sea is so big, I can't see the end of it.
The waves go rumble, rumble.
I hold Dad's hand tight.

pages.zh:
爸爸说：
「我们不下水，
就坐在这里看。」
沙子是干的，暖暖的。
pages.scene: A little boy and his father sitting together on warm dry sand near the top of a beach, seen from the side, the sea far away in the background, a folded towel beside them, calm and unhurried.
pages.en:
Dad says,
“We won't go in the water.
We'll just sit here and watch.”
The sand is dry and warm.

pages.zh:
浪跑过来了——
我往后缩了一下。
可是它没有过来。
它停住了，然后回去了。
pages.scene: A thin sheet of seawater running up wet sand toward a little boy's bare feet and stopping short of them, the boy leaning back slightly, low viewpoint close along the sand, gentle foam edge.
pages.en:
Here comes a wave—
I scoot back a little.
But it doesn't come all the way.
It stops, and then it goes back.

pages.zh:
又来了一次。
还是停在那里。
再来一次。
每一次，都停在同一个地方。
pages.scene: Three thin curved lines of foam left on wet sand at the same distance from the viewer, marking where each wave stopped, a gentle repeating pattern on an empty beach, soft daylight from above.
pages.en:
Here it comes again.
It stops in the same place.
And again.
Every time, it stops in the very same spot.

pages.zh:
我数：一、二、三……
浪就来了。
一、二、三……
浪就回去了。
原来它是有拍子的。
pages.scene: A little boy sitting on the sand counting on his fingers, mouth open counting, a small wave rolling in gently behind him, bright and calm.
pages.en:
I count: one, two, three…
and the wave comes in.
One, two, three…
and the wave goes out.
So it has a beat!

pages.zh:
浪回去以后，
沙子上留下了东西：
一个白色的贝壳，
一根海草，
还有一个小小的洞。
pages.scene: Close up of wet sand after a wave has gone, a single white spiral shell, one strand of dark seaweed, and a small round hole in the sand with tiny bubbles, seen from above.
pages.en:
When the wave goes back,
it leaves things on the sand:
a white seashell,
a piece of seaweed,
and a tiny little hole.

pages.zh:
岩石中间有小水坑。
那是浪走的时候，
忘记带走的一点点海。
这种小水坑叫「潮池」。
pages.scene: A shallow rock pool between grey rocks, clear still water, seaweed around the rim, sunlight on the surface, small movement in the water, quiet and inviting.
pages.en:
Between the rocks there are little pools of water.
They're a little bit of sea
the waves forgot to take with them.
These little pools are called “tide pools.”

pages.zh:
里面住着好多小东西：
一只小螃蟹，横着走。
一条小鱼，比我的手指还短。
还有一颗海星，
慢慢地、慢慢地爬。
pages.scene: Inside a clear rock pool seen from above: a small crab walking sideways, a tiny fish shorter than a finger, and an orange starfish moving slowly across the bottom, pebbles and green seaweed, bright clear water.
pages.en:
Lots of little creatures live inside:
a tiny crab, walking sideways,
a little fish, shorter than my finger,
and a starfish,
crawling slowly, slowly.

pages.zh:
它们一点也不怕。
它们在等下一次浪来，
接它们回家。
pages.scene: A rock pool with small sea creatures resting quietly among the rocks, and beyond the rocks the sea further out with one gentle wave approaching in the distance, warm afternoon light.
pages.en:
They aren't scared at all.
They're waiting for the next wave
to come and take them home.

pages.zh:
我站起来，慢慢走过去。
浪来了，碰到我的脚。
凉凉的，痒痒的。
然后它就回去了。
我说：「明天我还来。」
pages.scene: A little boy standing at the very edge of the water, a thin sheet of foam just touching his bare feet, looking down at his own feet and smiling, calm sea behind, gentle low sunlight.
pages.en:
I stand up and walk over slowly.
A wave comes in and touches my feet.
It's cool and tickly.
Then it goes back out.
I say, “I'll come back tomorrow.”
